label: Figure 15.2: The straight-line SRAS curve
alt: A straight upward-sloping SRAS curve. Output Y1 has price level P1 and higher output Y2 has higher price level P2.
caption: The simplified SRAS curve is drawn as a straight upward-sloping line: a rise in real output from Y<sub>1</sub> to Y<sub>2</sub> is accompanied by a rise in the average price level from P<sub>1</sub> to P<sub>2</sub>. This is the version used in most diagrams in the chapter.
